newsitem.title: USA: Sun tells union plans to lay off workers.
newsitem.headline: Sun tells union plans to lay off workers.

text.p: Sun Co said Wednesday that one of its units had announced plans to lay off some workers at a refinery in Toldeo, Ohio in an effort to reduce costs and improve its competitiveness.
The company said in a statement that Sunoco MidAmerica provided Local 7-912 of the Oil Chemical and Atomic Workers (OCAW) Union with 90 days notice of the layoffs.
It said Sunoco planned to reduce the refinery workforce by 67 hourly employees.
"As stipulated in the labor agreement, management will meet with the union to discuss the effects of the cutbacks," it said.
The company said its decision came after a month of failed talks with the union about how to improve the unit's competitiveness.
